messages:
alex: FYI opened PR for HSM-backed keyflow and secrets rotation for Private. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821
Changed: onprem/kms_adapter, auth/rotator, ci/pre-commit hook. Need security review on key material handling + audit logging before we merge. cc @maria @jordan

maria: Thanks. Can you confirm whether any plaintext key material is ever written to object storage or logs? Also need a short threat model note and design doc link.

alex: No plaintext at rest. We generate ephemeral wrapping keys inside HSM and only store wrapped keys. design doc: https://docs.internal/reviews/hsm-keyflow (private). Keyflow summary:
```
// simplified
generate customer_master_key in HSM (non-exportable)
wrap data_key with customer_master_key -> store wrapped_data_key
on request: unwrap in HSM -> decrypt in memory -> discard
```

jordan: We need a migration plan for existing wrapped keys and a rollout that avoids downtime. Are you adding DB migrations and rotator backfill? Also will this touch the Dedicated pools auth flows?

alex: Yes. Migration plan in PR description:
- backfill tool to rewrap legacy keys using HSM (batch, rate-limited)
- rotator runs with feature flag `hsm_keyflow_enabled`
- canary on 5% of accounts for 24h
Dedicated auth flow uses same API; no changes to token schema.

sre-oncall: Any impact on latency for token validation path? HSM unwrapping per-request might add ms. Recommend caching unwrapped keys in secure memcache for short TTL (30s) with access control.

alex: Agreed. We implemented a per-host in-memory cache + optional memcache. Measured extra p95: +12ms without cache, +2ms with cache. Bench numbers attached in PR.

security-bot: pre-commit scan: no secrets detected. static-analysis: high-level crypto usage ok. flagged: need IAM role scoping for HSM service account.

maria: Please add explicit key policy snippets and IAM bindings in PR. Also need audit log entries showing unwrap/rotate events with user_id and request_id. Can you add log schema?

alex: Added sample log lines to PR:
```
INFO key_unwrap user_id=acct_123 request_id=7a4b2 ts=... key_id=wrapped_abc outcome=success
```

maria: Also: ensure customer master keys are FIPS-validated for EU customers — add conditional check and fallback to software key only for non-FIPS regions.

alex: Will do. One Q: merge timing — we need this to land before next week's Dedicated capacity deploy to avoid mismatch. Can security review + approve by EOD?

jordan: Heads up — merge freeze for infra starts tomorrow 00:00 UTC for 12h. If you need it before, must merge now or schedule after freeze window. Also SRE prefers canary during off-peak.

alex: We can push small fixes quickly. Proposed merge: 1832463000 (roughly 10 hours). Can @maria do a quick approve earlier?

maria: I can do a final pass in 90 minutes. If I see only checklist items, I'll approve. Please add KMS IAM snippets and log schema now.

alex: Done, pushed. Thanks :thumbsup:

jordan: LGTM from infra side once migrations are rate-limited. Please add migration throttle config.

maria: Reviewed diffs, left one minor comment about error messages leaking key ids — please redact key identifiers in logs except hashed id. After that, I'll approve.

alex: Updated logs to hash key id and removed raw ids. Pushed fix.

maria: Approving now. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: +1 for scheduling canary tonight 02:00 UTC for 6h.

alex: Great, merging after CI and will kick canary. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
